title: Sage music record
description: A music record (MusicRecord). Generated by `sage schema` from the metadata table (issue #21).

$schema.description: The JSON Schema an editor checks this file with; the game ignores it.

id.description: The record's id: name (this file's namespace) or namespace:name. A second definition of an id is an error; change one with "patch".

base.description: Inherit every field from another music record, resolved after patches; this record's own fields win.

patch.description: true: change a record defined earlier in load order, field by field, instead of defining one. Objects merge; lists replace unless written "field+" (add) or "field-" (remove).

abstract.description: true: a template, usable as a "base" and never built into a record itself.

disabled.description: true (in a patch): remove the record.

track.description: The track: an Ogg Vorbis (.ogg) file, streamed as it plays. A sound path. (AssetPath)

layers.description: Stems played in step with the track, each heard while the world's music intensity is at or above its own. (List<MusicLayer>)

asset.description: The stem: an Ogg Vorbis (.ogg) file as long as the track, streamed in step with it. A sound path. (AssetPath)

volume.description: Loudness beside the track. Range: 0 to 1. (float)

intensity.description: Heard while the world's music intensity is at or above this; 0: always. Range: 0 to 1. (float)

fade.description: Seconds it takes to come in or go out as the intensity crosses its own. Unit: s. At least 0. (float)

layers+.description: Adds to "layers": what a base or an earlier definition listed, then these.

asset.description: The stem: an Ogg Vorbis (.ogg) file as long as the track, streamed in step with it. A sound path. (AssetPath)

volume.description: Loudness beside the track. Range: 0 to 1. (float)

intensity.description: Heard while the world's music intensity is at or above this; 0: always. Range: 0 to 1. (float)

fade.description: Seconds it takes to come in or go out as the intensity crosses its own. Unit: s. At least 0. (float)

layers-.description: Removes these from "layers" (as a base or an earlier definition listed it).

asset.description: The stem: an Ogg Vorbis (.ogg) file as long as the track, streamed in step with it. A sound path. (AssetPath)

volume.description: Loudness beside the track. Range: 0 to 1. (float)

intensity.description: Heard while the world's music intensity is at or above this; 0: always. Range: 0 to 1. (float)

fade.description: Seconds it takes to come in or go out as the intensity crosses its own. Unit: s. At least 0. (float)

volume.description: Loudness before the Music and Master buses. Range: 0 to 1. (float, default 1)

loop.description: Play it again when it ends; off: it plays once and the music is silent after it. (bool, default true)

loopStart.description: Where a loop winds back to, in samples per channel from the start: an intro before it plays once. Unit: samples. At least 0. (long, default 0)

loopEnd.description: Where a loop wraps, in samples per channel from the start; 0: the end of the file. Unit: samples. At least 0. (long, default 0)

fadeIn.description: Seconds it takes to come in, crossfading from what was playing (unless the change names its own) Unit: s. At least 0. (float, default 2)

fadeOut.description: Seconds it takes to fade to silence when the music is stopped (unless the stop names its own) Unit: s. At least 0. (float, default 2)
